verdict.rationale: Stagehand's first-party docs describe `observe()` as discovering actionable elements on the current page and returning structured actions that can be executed or validated before acting. That is exactly the preview-before-commit workflow in the story. Integrations also expose a `snapshot` tool for inspecting page state before acting. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the returned action shape and how an observed action is passed into act(), and independent or hands-on corroboration of observe-then-act usage.
